measure: Missed call re-slot after a server restart, local
value: median 773 ms, from 401 to 784 ms after the grace end
method: Local server with future calls on. A patient was called with a 60 s grace window, the server was killed about 22 s in and started again, and a client polling every 500 ms timed the re-slot against the grace end.

measure: Missed call re-slot after a redeploy, Serverpod Cloud
method: Serverpod Cloud Starter plan with the in-process sweep. A redeploy ran inside a 180 s grace window, and a client polling every 500 ms timed the re-slot against the grace end.

measure: Reconnect, network back to the new place on the phone
method: Serverpod Cloud from Lagos. Playwright took the phone offline for 8 s while the desk called, then timed how long the phone took to show its new place.
Chromium with Chrome DevTools' Fast 3G profile and the cache off, from navigation to the ticket label on screen, against the live app on Serverpod Cloud

value: p95 196 ms, p50 180 ms, max 209 ms
method: Local, with the server and 300 clients on one M1 Pro. The desk called every 2 s for 15 calls, and each of the 4,500 samples is the time from the desk's action to a phone getting the new line.

measure: Idle stream survival on Serverpod Cloud
method: Three streams from Lagos sent one value, stayed silent for 600 s with the default 30 s ping, then sent another. Two lived the full 600 s and one closed at 562 s. A stream that closes reconnects on its own.
